lines.text: The people cry out against their fellow Jews, mortgaging fields, vineyards and homes for grain during the famine.
Nehemiah becomes extremely angry, rebukes the nobles and officials for charging usury, and calls a large assembly against them.
Nehemiah asks the nobles and officials to restore the people's fields, vineyards, olive groves and houses immediately.
Nehemiah summons the scribes and makes the nobles and officials swear an oath, and the assembly says "Amen."
Nehemiah serves as governor for twenty years and never eats the governor's food allotment, because the burden on the people is heavy.
